'''2018 European Championship Day 2 Piotr Dash R DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Piotr Dash_R]] at [[2018 European Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Piotr Dash_R]]
* '''Event:''' [[2018 European Championship]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Carbon Chamber Testing / My Favorite Decoration|SE-D-carbonchambertesting.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open CCT Dash R DS 2018 EC.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20210127125624/https://www.starwarsccg.org/2018-european-championships/ Internet Archive]
